title: Developing an AI-powered translation app to improve workplace safety at construction and shipbuilding worksites
summary: Crowdworks reports over 90% translation accuracy and user satisfaction in multilingual field testing of construction-focused Safety Talk.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Crowdworks and an anonymized construction firm developed a translator using specialized terminology and worker feedback. The source reports field testing in more than 20 languages and over 90% accuracy and satisfaction. These are communication-performance claims. Prevention of injuries and wider productivity gains are intended effects, not separately measured outcomes.
purpose: Improve communication of specialized workplace instructions across languages.
developer: Crowdworks AI and anonymized Company S
location: South Korean construction and shipbuilding worksites

ratings.reason: Field tests report over 90% accuracy for specialized translation in more than 20 languages, supporting improved task capability relative to the described terminology failures.
Multilingual field testing reports over 90% user satisfaction with specialized workplace translation, supporting a claimed communication improvement rather than proof of injury prevention.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Developing an AI-powered translation app to improve workplace safety at construction and shipbuilding worksites

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Safety Talk improves specialized workplace translation

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
